## Evidence

- **Before:** the strip is absent; the backlog UI also leaves a stale link caption on descendant exit and paints the runtime caption too wide/dim.
  **After:** native/mock strip tests cover link births4/6/8/10, in-flight reversal, internal target transitions, background caption clearing, Settings parking/return, keyboard activation and four offline destinations without requests/popups. Pinned source distinguishes plain-text defaults from initial HTML formatting; the corrected native caption matches the original158px horizontal extent and opaque white. One top raster row still differs. Mock tests also preserve the stopped-frame alpha repaint and signed8.8 overshoot25→26.

- Native hit contours, mouse-up versus DOM click delivery, hover re-evaluation after artwork moves, global phase and exact font/filter pixels remain open. The next pointer checkpoint addresses input geometry/delivery; complete menu/game parity is unproven.
